title: Multicenter observational study for patients with haemophilia A for treatment with efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) during surgical operations
summary:
The project was designed as a non-interventional, multicenter, prospective and retrospective observational study for surgical interventions from the approval of Altuvoct®.
The study is open to all hemophilia centers in Germany, Switzerland and Austria (once reimbursement for efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) is available) and is being conducted by the Hemophilia Commission of the GTH. 
The safety and efficacy of therapy with efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) in patients with hemophilia A during an invasive procedure is to be investigated. In this regard, data on the use and efficacy of efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) will be collected in a real-world setting. The data collected will be used to create Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) in the clinics and treatment centers to increase the safe use of Efanesctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) during surgical procedures.

interventions.name: Patients with hemophilia A who are treated with efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) during surgical procedures

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with haemophilia A and surgical intervention
- Treatment with efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) perioperatively
- Patients undergoing therapy with emicizumab who receive efanesoctocog alfa (Altuvoct®) in addition to the surgical procedure
Exclusion criteria:
- Known blood coagulation disorders other than hemophilia A
- Treatment with other factor VIII preparations perioperatively
- Known active factor VIII inhibitor (≥ 0.6 Bethesda units (BU)/ml)
- History of hypersensitivity or allergy to factor VIII preparations
- Failure to provide written informed consent
